sample_unit: synthetic FHIR bundles derived from clinician-authored diagnostic cases

links.outcome: LLM diagnostic accuracy on structured FHIR inputs versus plain-text inputs
links.effect: LLMs showed consistently lower diagnostic accuracy on structured FHIR inputs than on plain text. Specific accuracy numbers are not given in the abstract.
links.quote: Evaluation on MedCase-Structured reveals consistently lower diagnostic accuracy for LLMs on structured FHIR inputs than with plain text, highlighting the importance of deployment-aligned benchmarking.

unlisted_practices: Terminology-grounded validation and repair of LLM-generated FHIR bundles to remove hallucinated codes and enforce structural and semantic consistency
Generating synthetic FHIR R4 bundles from unstructured text to benchmark clinical decision support over EHR-congruent structured inputs

screen.reason: The study develops a synthetic FHIR-bundle dataset (MedCase-Structured) and benchmarks LLM diagnostic reasoning accuracy on structured EHR inputs versus plain text, without testing a deployment safeguard or practice.
